name: Košice

queries.query: Košice Slovakia official cadastral map parcel viewer API kataster map
queries.result: Found the official City of Košice GISPLAN cadastral map viewer. It identifies the cadastral layer as Kataster: ÚGKK SR and exposes parcel identification in the public map UI. Found the official Slovak geodesy WFS publication page and national C-register parcel WFS.

queries.query: Slovensko Košice oficiálna katastrálna mapa parcely mapový klient API
queries.result: Found the official Košice GISPLAN Katastrálna mapa and the official Slovak geoportal/geodesy publication describing open C- and E-register cadastral parcel data. The Košice map is a local public viewer; the WFS is the national first-party service operated/published through VÚGK/ÚGKK SR.

freshResearch.searchScope: First-party discovery only; no login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, private fields, or unsafe owner/titleholder/address/contact fields used.

registryEvidence.localCustodian: City of Košice GISPLAN public cadastral map viewer
registryEvidence.nationalCustodian: Research Institute of Geodesy and Cartography in Bratislava (VÚGK), under the Slovak geodesy/cadastre authority ecosystem (ÚGKK SR)
registryEvidence.evidence: The local viewer is a public cadastral map for Košice and displays parcel identification; the national WFS GetCapabilities describes the C-register cadastral parcel layer for Slovakia and names VÚGK as provider.

service.scope: Slovakia C-register cadastral parcels; not a Košice-only service
service.nativeIdentityPreference: inspireId.localId or nationalCadastralReference; WFS feature id is also available as CP.<number>. Do not use a synthetic row number.

boundedEvidence.broadRequestOutcome: HTTP 200 anonymous JSON; numberMatched=9556, numberReturned=3, full polygon geometries and safe parcel metadata returned.
boundedEvidence.exactNeighborhoodOutcome: HTTP 200 anonymous JSON; parcel polygons returned in the small neighborhood query. This is not evidence that the exact WUP point lies inside a parcel.

uncertainty: The national WFS is first-party and publicly queryable, but it is a Slovakia-wide service rather than a dedicated Košice adapter endpoint.
The bounded response demonstrates service availability and parcel geometry near the city point, not complete city coverage or point containment.
No adapter was admitted or runtime-qualified in this research packet.
